source.featureInput: r_i,t = ln(close_i,t / close_i,t-1); current and prior PIT feature values only

RAW_RETURN_REVERSAL.threshold: nearest-rank Q99 of abs(prior raw returns)
RAW_RETURN_REVERSAL.firstCross: abs(previous) < current-t threshold AND abs(current) >= current-t threshold
RAW_RETURN_REVERSAL.direction: positive SHORT; negative LONG; zero ineligible
RAW_RETURN_REVERSAL.overlap: same-symbol timestamp-only 30m; different symbols may be simultaneous

SIMPLE_MEDIAN_GAP_REVERSAL.feature: g_i,t = r_i,t - median(other seven returns at t)
SIMPLE_MEDIAN_GAP_REVERSAL.threshold: nearest-rank Q99 of abs(prior median gaps)
SIMPLE_MEDIAN_GAP_REVERSAL.firstCross: abs(previous) < current-t threshold AND abs(current) >= current-t threshold
SIMPLE_MEDIAN_GAP_REVERSAL.direction: positive SHORT; negative LONG; zero ineligible
SIMPLE_MEDIAN_GAP_REVERSAL.overlap: same-symbol timestamp-only 30m; different symbols may be simultaneous

TIME_MATCHED_RANDOM.role: placebo diagnostic only; not a promotion gate
TIME_MATCHED_RANDOM.matching: one placebo per accepted V21 event by symbol, YYYY-MM, UTC hour, and direction
TIME_MATCHED_RANDOM.candidateTimeline: synchronized historical 5m open timestamps from 2022-01-01 inclusive to 2026-08-01 exclusive
TIME_MATCHED_RANDOM.selection: xorshift32 + Fisher-Yates over ascending synchronized 5m timestamps

timeMatchedRandom.algorithm: derive seed from seed + symbol|YYYY-MM|UTC-hour|direction; xorshift32 + Fisher-Yates over ascending synchronized 5m timestamps
